info.name: Redirects API 🎯🎯🎯
info.description:
- Endpoint: `GET /redirect1/api.{json|xml}` - live and historical redirect history.
- Example: `https://api.builtwith.com/redirect1/api.json?KEY=YOUR_KEY&LOOKUP=example.com`
- Credits: 1 per lookup.

Sample response (`https://api.builtwith.com/samples/redirect_apiv_v1.json`):
```json
{
  "Lookup": "example.com",
  "Inbound": [
    {
      "Domain": "old-example.com",
      "FirstDetected": "2019-09-03T00:00:00Z",
      "LastDetected": "2021-12-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "Outbound": []
}
```

Updated 2026-11-10 from https://api.builtwith.com/llms-full.txt. Set KEY locally. Requests are examples; sending data requests may consume credits. Optional query parameters are disabled until selected.
